prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production spritesheet for a medieval isometric social tavern game in PixiJS. TRUE transparent RGBA background, absolutely no scenery, no floor, no ground shadows, no text, no grid lines, no logos. Rich hand-painted dark fantasy RPG art, realistic adult proportions, crisp readable silhouettes, aged cloth, leather, steel, warm amber light. NOT chibi, not cartoon, not pixel art, not a flat icon. Full body including all hair, headwear, hands, equipment and boots in each cell, generous transparent gutters. Orthographic elevated 2:1 isometric camera, every figure at identical scale. These are calm walking/social poses, no combat, no attack, no magic blasts. Keep identity, outfit and gear invariant across the six frames of each character. Weapons held low or stowed.
Layout is mandatory: a REGULAR 6 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid, preferably 1536x1536 PNG. Each row is ONE character preset, repeated in SIX animation frames. Column 1: front three-quarter view facing screen lower-right, left leg forward walking stride. Column 2: SAME front lower-right view, standing idle feet close together. Column 3: SAME front lower-right view, right leg forward walking stride. Column 4: BACK three-quarter view facing screen upper-right, left leg forward. Column 5: SAME back upper-right view, standing idle. Column 6: SAME back upper-right view, right leg forward. In columns 4-6 we see the BACK of the head and the BACK of the outfit, not the face. Exact 24 separate full-body figures, six figures per row, no missing/extra cells. The foot contact point must be centered horizontally and at the same vertical baseline inside each cell. Clear visible alternating leg strides, natural opposite arm swing; never change the equipment between frames. Do not draw labels.
Row 1: FIGHTER, practical burnished steel armor over navy gambeson, plain sword held down and round wooden shield. Row 2: PALADIN, bright heavy silver plate, ivory tabard with a simple original sun medallion, sword down and heater shield. Row 3: RANGER, olive leather armor, forest green cloak, recurved bow carried down and quiver on the back. Row 4: ROGUE, charcoal hood and fitted brown leather armor, two small lowered daggers, dark burgundy scarf. Adult androgynous adventurers, faces understated; these are class presets, not named characters.
